summary: Round-2 backend + frontend smoke testing for Auto Abodes. Added /app/backend/tests/test_round2_features.py covering all new endpoints: POST /api/jobs/{id}/status (in_progress sets checked_in_at, completed sets completed_at, cancelled status accepted, non-poster 403, admin override, invalid value 422), DELETE /api/jobs/{id} (poster + admin allowed, others 403, GET-after-DELETE returns 404), POST /api/jobs auto-geocoding via Nominatim (Times Square -> lat~40.7, lon~-74), GET /api/geocode (known address returns float lat/lng, unknown -> 404), and Teams CRUD (create, /teams/mine with members_info, add member by owner, non-owner 403). All 16 new tests passed (100%), and full regression of the round-1 suite (test_auto_abodes.py) re-ran with 30/30 passing — so combined 46/46 backend tests pass. Frontend Playwright smoke: navigated to /teams, confirmed testIDs (new-team-button, team-name-input, create-team-button, operations-card) render correctly with appropriate mobile design (proper spacing, ≥44px tap targets, themed cards). Operations entry-point card on Home is properly gated behind owner/admin role and present in code with testID=operations-card. NOTE: testing the full UI tap-through (Start/Done/Cancel/Delete + Assign modal) required an authenticated session — the email/password login submit didn't fully redirect to the tabs in the headless mobile viewport (likely because the script's text-based selector matched the 'Sign In' segmented tab rather than the submit button; the submit button lacks a testID). Recommend adding testID=login-submit so the UI tap-through can be deterministically scripted next iteration.

ui_bugs.issue: The 'Sign In' submit button lacks a testID. Both the segmented tab and the submit CTA share the text 'Sign In', making Playwright text-based selectors ambiguous and causing login automation to mis-click the tab.

action_items: (Minor) Add testID='login-submit' to the Sign In button on /auth so end-to-end mobile flows can be reliably automated.

(Cleanup) In /app/frontend/app/operations.tsx line 39 the `remove` handler contains a dead expression: `await (api as any).get;` which just references the method without invoking it. The actual delete is performed by fetchDelete(). Remove the dead line to avoid confusion.
Nominatim is rate-limited and shared (no key). For production consider caching coords on the address or adding a fallback geocoder; tests gracefully skip on transient failures.

The DELETE endpoint hard-deletes jobs even when they have a logged history in hours_log. Consider soft-delete (`status:'deleted'`) so cleaner stats remain intact and audit trail is preserved. Not blocking for current scope.
critical_code_review_comments: operations.tsx imports api but uses raw fetch via fetchDelete() for DELETE since the `api` wrapper only exposes get/post. Better: add api.del/delete helper and remove the dead `await (api as any).get;` line for consistency.

set_job_status accepts 'pending' from any prior state — no guard against illegal transitions (e.g. completed -> pending). Acceptable for the Owner-driven Operations UI but consider adding a state machine to prevent UX confusion.
delete_job permanently removes documents. hours_log entries referencing the job will then dangle. Consider soft-delete or cascading cleanup.
geocode_address uses a single Nominatim call with no retries/backoff/cache. Production should respect Nominatim's 1 req/sec policy and cache results by normalized address.
server.py reached 590 lines — close to the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into routers (auth.py, jobs.py, teams.py, chat.py) before adding more features.
add_member doesn't verify the cleaner_id corresponds to an existing user with role cleaner/owner_cleaner. Owner could $addToSet any string.

success_rate.frontend: smoke-only: testIDs verified, full tap-through deferred pending login-submit testID

seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed owner/cleaner users + jobs + one team per run via the public API. Admin (aestheticabodesyyc@gmail.com) auto-upgraded as before. No production data mutated.

BASE_URL comes from /app/frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. The geocoding test on Times Square may pytest.skip if Nominatim rate-limits the preview IP — this is expected and not a failure. For the UI tap-through, the auth screen's submit button needs a testID before reliable end-to-end scripting (use testID='login-submit'). All ops/teams testIDs (operations-card, start-/done-/cancel-/delete-/assign-/assign-pick-<id>, new-team-button, team-name-input, create-team-button, add-member-/pick-<id>) are confirmed wired in the code.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no functional bugs surfaced. The auth submit testID gap is the only friction blocking deterministic UI automation.
